Jeff, on Ghostty's default dark theme: "I'm not seeing some lines." Its background sits near the 256-color grays the TUI used for rules, borders and the header bar, so they vanish. The plan list is also hard to scan as two stacked lines a plan. And trying the TUI needs a draft, which is deleted after every try. Written straight to plans/: each is small, and Jeff said what he wanted.

Decision: Rules, borders and the header bar use the theme's own colors

where internal/tui/styles.go file page

quote rule: lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.AdaptiveColor{Light: "250", Dark: "238"}),

Because (Jeff, then Claude): a fixed gray is the same on every theme, and some themes' backgrounds are close to it. Palette colors 0 to 15 are the theme's, and themes set 8 ("bright black") to be readable as a quiet color. Rules, borders, the gutter and empty layers use 8. The header bar is reverse video, which shows on any theme.

Decision: Each plan is a box, with a gap between them

where internal/tui/screens.go file page

quote left = append(left, title, styles.dim.Render(ansi.Truncate(" "+meta(p), lw, "…")))

Because (Jeff): "a box around each of the plans with a bit of a gap-y." A box holds a plan's title and its dim line together, and the gap separates one plan from the next. The chosen plan's border is the terminal's own text color, and the rest are quiet. It costs room: five lines a plan, about six plans in a usual terminal. The list scrolls.

Decision: A sample draft is kept in testdata/, to copy in

where (new) testdata/sample.draft.md file page

made by the work, so there is nothing to resolve

Because (Jeff): "maybe we should keep one handy for now." cp testdata/sample.draft.md plan.draft.md puts it up, and deleting plan.draft.md and its notes takes it down. It isn't named plan.draft.md, so it's committed and never mistaken for a real draft. It has one prompt of each kind, an anchor that resolves, one whose quote isn't there, a where (new), and an entry with no anchor. Its anchors drift as the code changes, which is something to see too.

Guess: Nothing the TUI draws disappears on Ghostty's default theme
